主要内容: On March 18, 2020, Fabrizio Freda, President and Chief Executive Officer of The Estée Lauder Companies Inc., stated that the company is withdrawing its previous guidance for the fiscal 2020 second half and full year ending June 30, 2020, due to the broader impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on its global business. The company noted that most retail stores in North America and Europe are now closing, which has affected its business more than initially expected. The company plans to provide an update on the impacts of the pandemic and its recovery plans when it reports its next earnings on May 1, 2020. The company expressed concern for the health and safety of its employees and consumers and offered support to those affected by the coronavirus.
